program.name: Heavy Duty
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Full-body strength three ways, with heavier dumbbells and fewer, harder sets.
program.about: Full-body strength three ways, built on the heaviest moves you can do at home. Each day covers a squat or hinge, a press, a pull and a carry or core move, in straight sets with abs to finish. Days rotate so no pattern repeats back to back. Levels II and III both move you one weight up. For when your dumbbells are starting to feel light.
